# Prompt Engineering Guide

> > A comprehensive guide to prompt engineering for large language models including GPT-4, GPT-3.5, and other LLMs, maintained by DAIR.AI

This site provides extensive documentation on prompt engineering techniques, AI agent development, model-specific guides, and practical applications. It covers everything from basic prompting concepts to advanced topics like context engineering, function calling, and RAG systems, with support for multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- Prompt Engineering
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- AI Agents
- GPT-4 and GPT-3.5
- Context Engineering
- OpenAI API
- Function Calling
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- Fine-tuning
- Chain-of-Thought (CoT)
- Model Architecture
- Text Classification
- Prompt Injection
- n8n Integration
- DAIR.AI

## Getting Started

- [Prompt Engineering Guide](https://www.promptingguide.ai): Homepage for comprehensive LLM prompt engineering guide by DAIR.AI
- [Grundlagen des Promptings (German)](https://www.promptingguide.ai/de/introduction/basics): German: Prompt engineering basics for gpt-3.5-turbo and gpt-4

## AI Agents

- [Introduction to AI Agents](https://www.promptingguide.ai/agents/introduction): Introduction to autonomous AI agents with LLM planning and tool access
- [Agents Overview](https://www.promptingguide.ai/agents): Guide to AI agents and LLM agent design patterns with n8n integration
- [Agent Components](https://www.promptingguide.ai/agents/components): Agent architecture guide covering planning, memory, and tool utilization
- [Why Context Engineering?](https://www.promptingguide.ai/agents/context-engineering): Context engineering for AI agents with n8n system prompt design
- [Context Engineering Deep Dive](https://www.promptingguide.ai/agents/context-engineering-deep-dive): Deep research agent tutorial using Gemini 2.5 Pro multi-agent architecture

## Practical Applications

- [Function Calling with LLMs](https://www.promptingguide.ai/applications/function_calling): Function calling tutorial for GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 API integration
- [Fine-Tuning with GPT-4o Models](https://www.promptingguide.ai/applications/finetuning-gpt4o): GPT-4o fine-tuning guide for emotion classification via OpenAI API
- [Generating Synthetic Dataset for RAG](https://www.promptingguide.ai/applications/synthetic_rag): Synthetic data generation for RAG systems using GPT-4 and ChatGPT
- [Graduate Job Classification Case Study](https://www.promptingguide.ai/applications/workplace_casestudy): Job classification case study comparing GPT-3.5 and DeBERTa-V3 approaches

## Advanced Techniques

- [Generiertes Wissens-Prompting (German)](https://www.promptingguide.ai/de/techniques/knowledge): German: Generated knowledge prompting for commonsense reasoning in LLMs

## Model Guides

- [Gemini 1.5 Pro (German)](https://www.promptingguide.ai/de/models/gemini-pro): German: Gemini 1.5 Pro multimodal AI with long context window guide
- [Mixtral (German)](https://www.promptingguide.ai/de/models/mixtral): German: Mixtral 8x7B sparse mixture-of-experts model by Mistral AI

## Security & Risks

- [Prompt Injection in LLMs (German)](https://www.promptingguide.ai/de/prompts/adversarial-prompting/prompt-injection): German: Prompt injection vulnerabilities in GPT-4 and Mixtral models
- [Verzerrungen/Biases (German)](https://www.promptingguide.ai/de/risks/biases): German: Model biases in LLMs and few-shot learning distributions

## Additional Resources

- [Zusatzlektüre (German)](https://www.promptingguide.ai/de/readings): German: Additional reading resources on GPT-3, ChatGPT, and LLMs
